title: OpenAI's $110B Funding & AI Glasses Boom! — 2026-03-12
description: In today's episode, we dive into OpenAI's massive $110 billion funding round, led by giants like Amazon and NVIDIA, bringing its valuation to an astounding $730 billion. We'll explore how this influx of capital is set to shape the future of artificial intelligence. Plus, we'll discuss Anthropic's revenue surge and partnership plans with Blackstone, and the explosive growth in global AI glasses shipments, with Meta leading the market. Lastly, we'll cover Nebius's stock boost following NVIDIA's $2 billion investment and the jaw-dropping $50 billion valuation of Cursor AI. Don't miss out on these groundbreaking stories! Tune in now: https://aisimplify333.github.io/Daily-ai-News/listen/
